div.head: Ine 8
div.ab: Gif hwa him ryhtes bidde beforan hwylcum scirmen oððe deman ⁊ him ryht abiddan ne mæge, ⁊ him wedd syllan nelle, gebete XXX scll' ⁊ binnon VII nihtum gedó hine rihtes wyrðe.
LII. Gif hwa him ryhtes bidde beforan hwelcum scírmen oððe oþrum deman ⁊ ábiddan ne mæge, ⁊ him wedd sellan nelle, gebete XXX scill. ⁊ binnan VII nihton gedó hine ryhtes wierðne.
Si quis rectum sibi roget coram aliquo scirmanno uel alio iudice et habere non possit, et accusatus ei uadium (recti) dare nolit, emendet triginta sol. et infra septem noctes faciat ei recti dignum.
{LII} Gif hwa him ryhtes bidde beforan hwelcum scirmen oððe oþrum deman ⁊ ábbidan ne mæge, ⁊ him wedd sellan nelle, gebete xxx sciƚƚ ⁊ binnan vii nihton gedó hine ryhtes wierðne.

If someone demands justice before a certain shireman or another judge and he cannot obtain it, nor will [the accused] give him surety, let [the accused] pay 30 shillings and within 7 nights do for him such justice as he is entitled to.

If anyone demands justice in the presence of any shireman or of another judge and cannot obtain it, since [the accused] will not give him security, he [the accused] shall pay 30 shillings compensation, and within 7 days do him such justice as he is entitled to.

If anyone asks for justice in the presence of any official or other judge, and can not obtain it, and [the accused] will not give him a pledge, he [the accused] is to pay 30 shillings compensation, and within seven days make him entitled to justice.

Wenn einer sich [sein] Recht fordert vor irgend einem Amtmann oder einem anderen Richter und [es] nicht erlangen kann, indem [Verklagter] ihm ein Pfandversprechen [künftiger Urtheilserfüllung] nicht geben will, so büsse dieser [dem König] 30 Schill. und mache ihn binnen 7 Nächten der Urtheilserfüllung theilhaftig.

If someone demands [his] right before any official or another judge and cannot obtain [it], because [the accused] will not give him a pledge [of future fulfilment of judgment], let the latter pay [the king] 30 shillings and within 7 nights make him a partaker in the fulfilment of judgment.
